text:
Marta: heads up — my flight got delayed. I need to hand primary off for tonight 23:00-03:00 UTC. I'm currently primary and acknowledged the latency page earlier (incident #4523). Can someone take primary for that window? @Ryan @Sana

Ryan: I can take primary for 23:00-03:00 UTC. Quick Q: any ongoing mitigations I should keep an eye on? also, do you want me to start shadowing before you leave? :+1:

Marta: thanks Ryan. There's an open mitigation: rolling cache invalidation and a canary rollback queued. Status: 
- Pager acknowledged (22:14 UTC)
- Canary 1/3 rolled back, traffic at 12% to fallback
- KV cache warm-up in progress (ETA ~12m)
Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-mitigation (please read PREFLIGHT section)
If you take primary, please keep the canary paused and monitor token-serving latency at /metrics/token_latency.

eng-oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Alert "nlp-latency" triggered 22:12 UTC — acknowledged by Marta. Reminder scheduled 22:50 UTC for handoff check.

Sana: I can stay secondary and shadow until midnight, then go to standby. If Ryan needs escalation, ping me and I'll jump in. Two notes: 1) small flaky infra alert on zone-b switch that might cause brief 5xxs; 2) if you see a spike, run the quick fix below.

Omar: happy to be backup from 01:00-04:00 UTC in case Ryan gets pulled into deploys. Leaving checklist here for the handoff — copy/paste in your notes before you sign out, Marta:
```
Handoff checklist:
- Confirm pager forwarding: `opsctl oncall list-forwarding --team inference`
- Verify canary is paused: `kubectl -n redwood get rs | grep canary`
- Check token latency: open https://dash.redwood/internal/metrics?panel=token_latency (watch 95p)
- Ensure rollback playbook ready: /runbooks/rollbacks/quick-rollback.md
- Notify support: channels #support and #customer-impact if >5% error rate
```

Ryan: got it. I'll meet with Marta for 10m now for a quick live handoff. Marta — can you paste the exact query you used to check the cache warm-up earlier?

Marta: sure, this is what I ran in prod (read-only):
```sql
SELECT shard, count(*) AS warm_keys
FROM cache_metrics
WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY shard;
```
Results showed most shards warming but two still low (us-east-1a and eu-west-1c). I flagged them in the runbook.

Ryan: thanks — useful. I'll monitor those shards and keep canary traffic paused. Sana, if I need an escalation, I'll ping `@Sana` and add Omar if needed.

Sana: ACK. Also adding quick escalation steps here: if token_latency 95p > 800ms for >5m -> 1) increase fallback weight to 100% 2) trigger emergency autoscale for model-pool-3 3) open incident bridge. I keep that in my pager cheat sheet.

Marta: sweet, thank you all. I'll DM Ryan the deploy keys and the exact dashboard links. Leaving the formal handoff note in case ops audit needs it: primary handed to Ryan at 22:46 UTC; Marta leaving at 22:55 UTC; Sana remains secondary.

eng-oncall-bot: Note recorded: primary ownership change logged (from Marta -> Ryan) at 22:46 UTC. Reminder: escalate to #incident-bridge after 3 unacked pages or 15m of elevated latency.

Ryan: I'm primary. Confirmed all checks pass at 22:52 UTC. I'll post an update on any anomalies. :rocket:
